WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.*,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS pid,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS actor
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT distinct_id, MIN(person_id) AS person_id
    FROM identities
    WHERE project = 'demo'
    GROUP BY distinct_id
  ) i ON i.distinct_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = 'demo'
    AND e.ts_ms >= 1792432577474
    AND e.ts_ms < 1795110977474
    AND e.event IN ('document_created')
),
first_seen AS (
  SELECT actor, MIN(ts_ms) AS t0 FROM ev WHERE event = 'document_created' AND 1 = 1 AND ts_ms < 1795024577474 GROUP BY actor
),
c AS (
  SELECT fs.actor, (((fs.t0 / 86400000) - (((fs.t0 / 86400000) + 3) % 7)) * 86400000) AS cbucket, MIN('') AS bd
  FROM first_seen fs JOIN ev e ON e.actor = fs.actor AND e.ts_ms = fs.t0 AND e.event = 'document_created' AND 1 = 1
  GROUP BY fs.actor, (((fs.t0 / 86400000) - (((fs.t0 / 86400000) + 3) % 7)) * 86400000)
),
a AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT actor, (((ts_ms / 86400000) - (((ts_ms / 86400000) + 3) % 7)) * 86400000) AS abucket
  FROM ev
  WHERE event = 'document_created' AND 1 = 1
)
SELECT c.cbucket AS cohort, c.bd AS bd, (a.abucket - c.cbucket) / 604800000 AS k, COUNT(DISTINCT c.actor) AS n
FROM c JOIN a ON a.actor = c.actor
WHERE a.abucket > c.cbucket AND (a.abucket - c.cbucket) / 604800000 <= 8
GROUP BY c.cbucket, c.bd, (a.abucket - c.cbucket) / 604800000
UNION ALL
SELECT cbucket AS cohort, bd, 0 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n FROM c GROUP BY cbucket, bd
